businesses.business: Permian Basin midstream natural gas services

offering_description.value: Provides gathering, compression, processing and transportation of natural gas, plus crude oil and produced water gathering, in the Delaware Basin of the Permian. Serves oil and gas producers through fee-based contracts using its owned pipelines and processing plants.

primary_services.value: natural gas gathering and compression; natural gas processing; natural gas pipeline transportation; crude oil gathering; produced water gathering and disposal

customer_segment.value: B2B: oil and gas exploration and production companies, and marketers in the Delaware Basin

end_markets.value: oil and gas; natural gas; power generation; LNG and Gulf Coast markets

revenue_model.value: service fees: fee-based gathering, compression, processing, transportation and water handling, often under long-term acreage dedications

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs gathering systems, processing plants and pipelines taking producers' gas, crude and water

geography_served.value: US regional: Delaware Basin in West Texas and southeastern New Mexico, with pipelines connecting to Texas Gulf Coast

specialization.value: related lines: natural gas midstream plus crude and water gathering in one basin

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct long-term contracts with producers and gas buyers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FERC and Texas Railroad Commission rules for interstate and intrastate pipelines, PHMSA safety and EPA air rules
